messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: No more .Rdata extensions.
parts:
All the *.Rdata files have been moved to either *.data.R or *.init.R.

I've gone through and made appropriate changes to the doc (introduction and appendix), but if there are any places where the wrong extension is used, I missed it. Feel free to change it to the appropriate extension.


I'm still hunting down the Windows issue with g++ 4.6.3 and -std=c++0x. The compiler process just dies without any messages. I'm remoting into the desktop in the office. If anyone would like a login into that machine to try any Windows specific stuff, please let me know.




Daniel

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: No more .Rdata extensions.
parts:
On Monday, November 26, 2012 5:50:50 PM UTC-5, Daniel Lee wrote:
All the *.Rdata files have been moved to either *.data.R or *.init.R.

I would have ended them with .txt or .dump or something. If the terminal extension is .R, then RStudio / people / etc. would expect it to be R code to execute.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: No more .Rdata extensions.

The file format IS R source code.

The usage follows Martyn Plummer's convention for
the JAGS examples, e.g.

http://sourceforge.net/p/mcmc-jags/examples/ci/f99efe6ba0fb51ed5a1b3620ffdaba6bec8df78d/tree/classic-bugs/vol1/blocker/
